title: The Prom of Maple Street
author: J. M. Ashgrove
blurb: Elodie Delacroix, a scholarship student at an academy with too many secrets, counts days until graduation like a sentence being served. Then grandma's recipe box contains directions that aren't for food — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must win the championship that doesn't matter — and the one that does before prom.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
